note.ja: 熱異常には植生火災も含まれ、検知が火山の熱を意味するとは限らない。

label.en: VIIRS (S-NPP) max fire radiative power within 15 km

note.en: Thermal anomalies include vegetation fires; a detection is not proof of volcanic heat.
note.ja: 熱異常には植生火災も含まれ、検知が火山の熱を意味するとは限らない。

label.en: FIRMS MODIS fire detections within 15 km

label.en: Ground motion along the satellite's line of sight, Sentinel-1 track 69 ascending (COMET LiCSBAS)
label.ja: 衛星視線方向の地表変位(Sentinel-1 トラック69・北行軌道、COMET LiCSBAS)

note.en: Summit area (pixels within 2 km) minus COMET's reference area, relative to the first date. Positive = toward the satellite, negative = away; line-of-sight motion mixes vertical and east-west movement, so it is not uplift or subsidence by itself. los_std_mm is the spread of the summit pixels, not a formal error. Processed by COMET, not by Plumes. COMET LiCSBAS (COMET Volcano Portal, https://comet.nerc.ac.uk/comet-volcano-portal/), processed by COMET, not by Plumes; LiCSAR contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2018–2026. Changes made: reduced to a summit series and a mean velocity per frame. CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/)
note.ja: 山頂付近(2 km以内の画素)からCOMETの参照域を差し引いた値で、初回観測日を基準とする。正は衛星に近づく向き、負は遠ざかる向き。視線方向の変位は上下と東西の動きを含むため、それだけで隆起や沈降とは言えない。los_std_mm は山頂付近の画素のばらつきで、正式な誤差ではない。解析はCOMETによる(Plumesではない)。COMET LiCSBAS (COMET Volcano Portal, https://comet.nerc.ac.uk/comet-volcano-portal/), processed by COMET, not by Plumes; LiCSAR contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2018–2026. note.en: Shown only around eruptions (30 days either side of each GVP eruption, 7 days around each Tokyo VAAC advisory). Unitless; positive values mean UV-absorbing particles (ash, smoke or dust: not ash alone); no signal under cloud.
note.ja: 噴火の前後のみ表示(GVPの各噴火の前後30日、東京VAACの各情報の前後7日)。無次元。正の値は紫外線を吸収する粒子(火山灰・煙・砂塵で、火山灰だけではない)を示す。雲の下は観測できない。
